$comment: Brand assets that are not tokens, logos or illustrations. Each entry names its file and the environments it serves. colour-rules.json is the one source of the colour and background rules: generate.mjs renders it as foundations/brand-colour-rules.html (through colour-rules.template.html), colour-rules.md and colour-rules.agent.json. voice-rules.json is the one source of the verbal brand rules: generate.mjs renders it as foundations/brand-voice-rules.html (through voice-rules.template.html), voice-rules.md and voice-rules.agent.json.
